subject: OBJECT-COMPUTER paragraph (computer-name and implied equipment configuration)
notes: 12.3.6.4 GR2's 'may provide' element is not provided, so the witness is an INVARIANCE, not a diagnostic (a diagnostic would reject legal source). CONFORMANCE.md line 1003 makes TWO claims and the file now asserts BOTH. PART 1 (claim 1 - one object computer): one compilation group, four separate outermost units - a computer-name, a DIFFERENT computer-name, the paragraph with no name (GR3), no paragraph (GR4) - each computing the same equipment-configuration signature (BYTE-LENGTH over BINARY-LONG/BINARY-DOUBLE per 13.18.60.4 GR21, ORD per 15.70.1 under GR10's native sequence, and a class condition under GR6), all SAME, with a CONTROL leg that reports DIFFER. PART 2 (claim 2 - 'the clauses that follow it (PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE; CHARACTER CLASSIFICATION) behave identically with or without a name'): two further pairs of outermost units, L1OCW05/L1OCW06 writing PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE IS REV with and without a computer-name (12.3.6.4 GR9/GR11 make 'A' > 'B' true under ALPHABET REV IS "B" "A" - the observable tests/conformance/2023/pb78_object_computer_optional_name already pins), and L1OCW07/L1OCW08 writing CHARACTER CLASSIFICATION IS TR with and without a name (12.3.6.4 GR5a + GR7a). The four Part-1 legs run under the DEFAULT arms GR10 and GR6, the branches that apply precisely BECAUSE no clause is written, so Part 1 alone could not assert claim 2 - that was the refuted omission. The CC pair is compared to EACH OTHER and never to a pinned Turkish code point, so 8.2.1's runtime locale availability cannot make the golden environment-dependent; CC-NONZERO guards the vacuous case. Landing this also fills CONFORMANCE.md line 1003's 'Pinned by' cell for this row. || LANDER CORRECTION (golden-lane round 3): the writer's record named ONLY the CONFORMANCE.md anchor, and a DOC row's `is_observable` predicate reads the kind's `implementation-pattern` `^src/WiseOwl\.Cobol\.` over the row's OWN code-location list, so the row would have stayed a GAP with its witness green on disk. The two sites the determination is observed through are now named: the grammar rule that ACCEPTS `computerName objectComputerClause*` (CobolParserCore.g4#objectComputerParagraph) and the binder that walks `objectComputerParagraph` reading only its CLAUSES and never the computer-name (DataBinder.Switches.cs#SwitchBindSpecialNames) - which is exactly 12.3.6.4 GR2's 'may provide' element being not provided. || editions 85,2002,2014,2023 (kb/Work PB3173, S0b; DESIGN-conformance-suite.md §6 step 0): a facility that exists at every edition (the COBOL-85 nucleus, I-O, inter-program and SPECIAL-NAMES implementor-names; its arithmetic, the only arithmetic of COBOL-85, is what later editions name native).
